overview: The Goa Startup Policy is a state-level initiative by the Government of Goa to foster a robust startup ecosystem by providing financial and non-financial support to startups operating in Goa. It aims to position Goa as a preferred startup destination in India and a top 25 startup hub in Asia by 2025. The policy includes multiple incentive schemes such as seed capital, salary reimbursement, IPR reimbursement, and co-working space subsidies, administered by the Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC).
objectives: To make Goa an aspirational geographical and human resources base for high value start-ups
To invite the best entrepreneurial minds to make Goa their professional base, and thereby build a robust start-up eco-system in the state
To provide assistance to the Goan entrepreneurs and local start-ups
To endeavour to create at least 100 successful start-ups in Goa in the next 5 years, targeting generation of employment for atleast 5000 Goans
To ensure continuous evolution of policy measures and creation of a responsive policy framework for accelerating growth of the start-up ecosystem

To infuse technology-enabled real-world problem-solving skills into the Goan education system through collaboration between industry, academia and through the introduction of DIY modules as part of school curriculum and Massive Online Open Courses as part of University curriculum
eligibility: Start-up means an entity meeting the following criterion: 1. Up to ten years from the date of incorporation / registration in the State of Goa and/or operating in the State of Goa. 2. With annual turnover not exceeding INR 100 crore in any of the preceding financial years. 3. Incorporated as a Private Limited Company, a Registered Partnership Firm or a Limited Liability Partnership. 4. Should be working towards the innovation, development or improvement of a product, process or service and/or have a scalable business model. The entity should not have been formed by splitting up or reconstructing an already existing business.
benefits: Benefits include reimbursement for co-working spaces/incubators/accelerators (up to INR 6000 per seat for accelerators, INR 5000 for incubators, INR 3000 for co-working spaces, max 8 seats), salary reimbursement (50% of fresher salary up to INR 15,000/month per recruit, max 25 people for 3 years), lease rental subsidy (up to INR 20/- per sq ft per month for local startups in rented premises, cap INR 3 lakh/annum), internet/cloud/software reimbursement (up to INR 1 lakh/quarter for one year), seed capital grant (up to INR 10 lakh one-time), IPR reimbursement (up to 100% of costs, cap INR 2 lakh for national IP, INR 5 lakh for international IP), trademark reimbursement (50% of cost up to INR 25,000), R&D reimbursement (50% of expenses including PhD/Master salaries, cap INR 5 lakh/annum, salary cap INR 2 lakh), grant for incubation centers in educational institutes (up to INR 10 lakh capital, INR 3 lakh/year operational for 3 years), and skill development promotion scheme benefits for educational institutes.
financial_support: Financial support varies by scheme: Seed Capital Scheme offers a one-time grant of up to INR 10 lakh; Salary Reimbursement Scheme provides 50% of fresher salary capped at INR 15,000/month per recruit for up to 25 people over 3 years; Co-Working Spaces/Incubators/Accelerators Subsidy Scheme reimburses 50% of seat cost with caps of INR 3000 (co-working), INR 5000 (incubator), INR 6000 (accelerator) per seat, max 8 seats; IPR Reimbursement Scheme covers up to 100% of IP registration fees (INR 2 lakh national, INR 5 lakh international); Trademark Reimbursement Scheme reimburses 50% of trademark registration cost up to INR 25,000; R&D Reimbursement Scheme covers 50% of R&D expenses including PhD/Master salaries, capped at INR 5 lakh per annum with salary component not exceeding INR 2 lakh; Grant for Incubation Centers provides up to INR 10 lakh for capital expenses and INR 3 lakh per year for operational expenses over 3 years.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to INR 10 lakh (Seed Capital Scheme), INR 25,000 (Trademark), INR 2 lakh (national IPR), INR 5 lakh (international IPR), INR 5 lakh per annum (R&D), INR 10 lakh capital + INR 3 lakh/year operational (Incubation Grant)
application_process: 1. Register on the Startup Goa portal (startup.goa.gov.in) to obtain a startup certificate from the Startup and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC). 2. Ensure eligibility as per the specific scheme (e.g., turnover < INR 100 crore, incorporated < 10 years, Private Limited Company/LLP/Partnership Firm). 3. Gather required documents (address proof, cancelled cheque, Aadhaar-linked bank accounts, etc., varying by scheme). 4. Apply for the specific incentive scheme via the Startup Goa portal or designated application link. 5. Submit application with documents for SPC due diligence and panel of experts review. 6. Await approval/rejection; if approved, request payment via the incentive application process. 7. Receive disbursement from the ITG (Disbursing Body) after approval.

deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications (DITE&C), Government of Goa
contact_details: Email: spc-dit[dot]goa[at]gov[dot]in | Phone: 1800-233-5060 | Office Address: IT HUB, 2nd Floor, Altinho, Panaji - Goa, 403001
caveats: Benefits under all schemes are not considered an entitlement; SITPC reserves the sole right to accept or reject applications
Only expenditure incurred after notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2021 and paid digitally is considered for reimbursement
Bank accounts of directors and/or employees must be linked to Aadhaar
Digital payment is mandatory unless SITPC makes an exception per guidelines
Certain schemes have annual caps (e.g., 100 startups for Seed Capital, 200 for IPR/trademark, 20 for co-working space subsidy)
Local startup definition requires at least 50% equity held by Goans continuously since inception
Fresher definition limited to graduates/postgraduates within 2 years of completion
Salary reimbursement requires employment period of at least 12 months
R&D salary reimbursement capped at INR 2 lakh despite overall cap of INR 5 lakh
Co-working space subsidy limited to 2 years (co-working), 1 year (incubator), 3 months (accelerator) per startup
Trademark reimbursement only available after successful trademark registration
IPR reimbursement not available if same IP applied for under another central/state scheme
